content: Naibe-buna-yaa-nikusar, san-urukoed-igar
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogded:
“Dule-naibe-buna-yaa-nikusad na e-san-urukega, weyob ega igar-mai guoed: Dule-irwa-anse-goledse we-dule seledoed.
Geb dule-irwa-anse-goled, we-dule-e-uka-dakega, dulemar-danar-danar-bukwad-magaba nodoed. Ar dule-irwa-anse-goled, naibe-buna-yaa-siid nugusa dakele,
we-dule-e-san-urukega, nuu-dulad-swilidikid-gwabo, urwar-urgo, morgo-ginnid, degi, hisopo-ana, sedagoye sogoed.
Geb a-sorbali, dule-irwa-anse-goled ibe-dii napsa-noggi-sioed. Geb a-birgi nuu-gwagwen oburgoed.
Geb degine, nuu-dulad, urwar-urgo, morgo-ginnid, degi, hisopo-ana suoed. Geb we-ibmarmar nuu-duladba-mesa, nuu-oburgwilesad-e-abegi owardikuoed.

Dule-irwa-anse-goled dule-naibe-buna-yaa-nika-gusadgi ilagugle (7) abe bomi-bomi imakoed. Geb dule-swilidikgusye sogsad-sorbali, dule-irwa-anse-goled nuu-dulad indakoed, adi, nuu e-itolegedba sapurba gukumai guegar.

”Dule-san-uruknaid e-mor enukoed, bela e-sailagia, e-siga swiri-imakoed, degi, diigi nue oboed, adi, swilidik guegar. Geb a-sorbali, dule-nugusad, sunna dulemar-danar-danar-bukwadse dogoed. Degi-inigwele, ibagugle (7) e-dordonegyaba gabosulid.
Ibagugledgine (7), gannar e-sailagia, e-aku-siga, e-ibya-siga bela swiri imakoed. Na e-mormar enukoed, ise-obar imakbaloed. Deyobi, we-dule swilidik gunonikoed.
”Geb dule-nugusad ibabaabakgine (8) we-ibmarmar-ukleged senonikoed:

content.text: degi, ibmar-gwag-uklegedga madubur-nued nibirambe-gakatar (15) olivo-gwalluba-omukuar sedabaloed,

content: ”Dule-irwa-anse-goled dulega-san-uruknaidi, we-dule, degi, e-ibmarmar-ukleged dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neg-yawagakse an-asabin bana-bana imakoed, ar ade, wemar bana-bana-ibmar-uklegedid.

Geb sorbali, dule-irwa-anse-goled sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwad-wargwen olivo-gwallu-litro-abalad-mesa suoed, geb a-ibmar-sulesad dule-isgusad-ular Bab-Jehováʼga ukoed. Geb Bab-Jehová-asabin bana-bana imakoed, ar ade, wemar bana-bana ibmar-uklegedid.

Dule-irwa-anse-goled neg-islidikidgi bia isgued-ular ibdurgan-e-dukar-egwallege, degi, bia ibdurgan-ogumakar-ukleged-e-dukar-egwallege, agi sibad-wawaad-bipigwad-e-dukar egwannoed. Ar isgued-ular-ibdurgan-ukleged, degi, na-dukin-isgusad-ular-ibdurgan-ukleged dule-irwa-anse-goledgadga gued, ar ade, we-ibmarmar nue-islidikidid.
”Geb dule-irwa-anse-goled dule-isgusad-ular, ibdurgan-uklenaid-e-abe weoed.
”Amba deyobi, dule-irwa-anse-goled olivo-gwallu-bute-abalad subaloed.

content.text: Geb olivo-gwallu-owardikusad an-asabin ilagugle (7) bomi-bomi imakoed.

content: ”Geb dule-irwa-anse-goled e-argan-nukugi olivo-gwallu-ganikid-obichadi, dule-san-uruknaidgi magoed:

content.text: Dule-irwa-anse-goled dule-san-uruknaid-e-isgued-elilegegala, an-asabin weyob ibmar imakoed.

content: ”Geb sorbali, dule-irwa-anse-goled dule-san-uruknaid-e-isgued-ular anga ibdurgan ogumakar ukoed. Deyobi, dule-san-swilidiksuli-gudiid, san swilidik gunonikoed. ”Agine, dule-irwa-anse-goled ibdurgan-ogumakar-uklegoed-e-dukar egwannoed.

Geb we-ibdurgan ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi anga ibmar-gwag-uklegedba-mesa ogumaklegoed. Dule-irwa-anse-goled dule-san-uruknaid-e-isgued-elilegegala, weyob ibmar imakoed. Geb we-dule san swilidik gunonikoed.

”Ar dule-san-uruknaid dule-wilegedirdi, sibad-wawaad-warbaagwad-bakega mani satele, adi, sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwad-wargwen e-isgusad-ular ukoed. We-sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwad, dule-e-isgued-elilegegala, bana-bana-imaklegar uklegoed. Deginbali, madubur-bur-nued-nibiratar olivo-gwalluba-omukualed, degi, olivo-gwallu-bute-abala, ibmar-gwag-uklegedyob sedbaloed.
Amba deyobi, wagnuu-gwabo, sapur-nuu-gwabodibe, e-mani-nikadba sedbaloed. Nuu-gwagwena, e-isgued-ular ukoed, baiddi, ogumakar ukoed.
We-ibmar, ibabaabakgine (8), dule-irwa-anse-goled-asabin sedagoed, adi, san swilidik guegar. Dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neg-yawagakgi an-asabin uknonikoed.
Dule-irwa-anse-goled sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwad-isgued-ular-uklenaid, degi, olivo-gwallu-bute-abala suoed. Geb an-asabin bana-bana-ibmar-uklegedyob ukoed.
Geb sorbali, sibad-wawaad-sapingwagwad-isgued-ular-uklenaid-e-dukar egwannoed. Dule-irwa-anse-goled, a-abe weoed.
”Geb a-sorbali, dule-irwa-anse-goled olivo-gwallu na e-argan-nuku-sapiledsikidgi eogoed.
”Geb e-argan-nuedsikid-e-goo-dummad-nagabalid we-olivo-gwallu-ganikidgi owardikuoed. Geb an-asabin olivo-gwallu ilagugle (7) bomi-bomi imakoed.
”Geb dule-irwa-anse-goled e-argan-nukugi olivo-gwallu-ganikid-obichadi, dule-san-uruknaidgi magoed:
”Dule-irwa-anse-goled e-argangi-olivo-gwallu-ganikid-obichadi dule-san-uruknaid-e-nonogi magoed, adi, deyobi, an we-dule-e-isgued ega elioed.
Geb a-sorbali, wagnuu-gwabo, sapur-nuu-gwabodibe, e-mani-nikadba ukoed.
Nuu-gwagwenad dule-isgued-ular uklegoed. Baiddi, ibmar-gwag-uklegedba-mesa ogumakar uklegoed. Dule-irwa-anse-goled dule-san-uruknaid-e-isgued-elilegega, an-asabin weyob ibmar imakoed.”
Dule-naibe-buna-yaa-nikusad san-urukegala, ibmar-baid geg-ukele, weyob ega igar mai guoed.
Neg-isgusad-uruklegoed-igar
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sogded:
“An bemarga Canaán-yar-uknaidse be dogsamalale, agi an bemar-neggi digwar nasikdemalale,
e-neg-ibed dule-irwa-anse-goled-owisonaoed, ega sogoed: ‘An-neg-galugi digwaryob nai an dakye.’

”Geb degine, dule-irwa-anse-goled neg-argaed-iduale, bela negyaba-ibmar-bukwad oniega imakoed, adi, bela negyaba-ibmar-bukwad melle isguegar. Deyob imaklesale, geb dule-irwa-anse-goled neg-argaega negyaba dogoed.
”Ar dule-irwa-anse-goled neg-arganaidgi neg-galugi digwar gordik, igi, gisii nai dakele, deginbali, we-gutu-nanaid yaa-bubukwayob daklebalile,
dule-irwa-anse-goled, a-neggi nodagoed. Geb ibagugle (7) a-neg ediar sioed.
Ibagugledgine (7), dule-irwa-anse-goled gannar neg-arganabaloed. Ar galugi-digwar-naid nasgusale,
dule-irwa-anse-goled igar-ukoed, akwamar-digwar-nikad ungemarye. Geb a-akwamar ibmar-isganamar-milegedgi, neggwebur-magaba minamaloed.
Deginbali, igar-ukbaloed, bela negyabali, galugi-napsa-magaled baad-baad imakmarye. Geb napsa-babatisadi ibmar-isgana-milegedgi, neggwebur-magaba minamaloed.
Geb degine, akwamar-onolesad-muchub, akwamar-binigan sioed, geb we-galu-birgi napsa-binid magoed.
”Ar galugi akwamar-onosad-sorba, galu-adarisad-sorba, degi, galu-maglesad-sorba, a-neggi gannar digwar nagualile,
dule-irwa-anse-goled we-neg gannar arganaoed. Ar a-neggine, digwar bela nasgusale, we-digwar ibmar-oichogedid. A-ulale, neg swilidiksuli gued.
Degisoggu, we-negde earilegoed, bela e-akwamar, e-urgomar, degi, bela we-neg-sobega-ibmar-ebulesmalad ibmar-isgana-milegedgi, neggwebur-magaba milegoed.
”Doa-dule, dule-irwa-anse-goled we-neg-edisad-ibagangine, we-negyaba dogsadibe, we-dule neg-mutikguedse swilidiksuli gudii guoed.
Dule a-neggi gabisale, mas-guchale, e-mor enukoed.
”Ar dule-irwa-anse-goled neg-argaega negyaba-dogsadgi dakalile, neg-maglesad-sorba bar digwar nasgussuli, sogoed: ‘We-neg, swilidik guye.’ Ar ade, digwar bar a-neggi naisulid.
”Dule-irwa-anse-goled neg-urukegala, nuu-gwabo-sedoed, deginbali, urwar-urgo, morgo-ginnid, degi, hisopo-ana sedbaloed.
Geb a-sorbali, dule-irwa-anse-goled ibe-dii napsa-noggi-sioed. Geb a-birgi nuu-gwagwen oburgoed.
Geb a-sorbali, urwar-urgo, hisopo-ana, morgo-ginnid, degi, nuu-dulad nuu-burgwisad-abegi, degi, dii-siidgi owardikuoed. Geb dule-irwa-anse-goled ilagugle (7) abe neggi bomi-bomi imakoed.
”Weyobi dule-irwa-anse-goled nuu-abegi, diigi, nuu-duladgi, urwar-urgogi, hisopo-anagi, degi, morgo-ginnidgi neg urukoed.
Geb degine, nuu-dulad neggwebur-magaba indakoed, adi, e-itolegedba sapurba gukumai guegar. Weyobi, neg urukoed, geb we-neg swilidik gunonikoed.
”Weyobi naibe-buna-yaa-maleged akar-akar-daklemaladga,
morgi-gutu-naguedga, neggi-digwar-naguedga,
uka-enguedga, yaa-sigedga, degi, ukagi-gutu-sipu-naguedga igar mai guoed.
Adi, bemar dulemar-odurdakega, sana wede ibmar swilidik gue, degi, sana wede ibmar swilidiksuli gue. Deyobi, naibe-buna-yaa-maleged-nikuedga igar mai guoed.”
